description: Expected-state contract for the rerunnable cleanroom verifier (cleanroom/verifier.py). All SHAs are the F13 observation snapshot; the verifier compares live state against them and records advances.

subject.note: Pinned at F14 write time. Authoritative CI runs pass --subject <commit> (the F15 implementation commit). Omit --subject to validate current HEAD; the actual tested commit is always recorded in the output.

main.note: main must remain exactly this SHA. If unrelated operator work moves it, this check FAILs and the observation is reported without altering main.

protected_branches_note: main has its own exact-match check; agent/repo-cleanroom is the worktree branch (subject check). Expected SHAs for these names come from branch-reference-manifest.json remote_heads (F13 observation snapshot).

restored_files.scope_note: Files listed in restored-file-manifest.json (50 Quant/CEREBUS/P90 files). Verified against working tree: existence + SHA-256 match + git blob match vs main.

trash.note: duplicate clone held for operator review; permanent deletion requires AUTHORIZED_STAGE=CLEANROOM-PERMANENT-DELETE
leftover legacy worktree dirs held in trash; contains a broken symlink (data -> /c/C:/...), so byte-count is 0 - existence is the requirement

lfs.note: LFS cache must be retained (no prune). git lfs status / git lfs ls-files are read-only.

gitleaks.scan_scope: cleanroom commits (scan_base..HEAD): answers whether the cleanroom introduced credentials
gitleaks.note: Repository CI contract (b1-i1r3-validation.yml on oce lineage) and the cleanroom CI both use gitleaks. Resolution order: GITLEAKS_BIN env, binary_paths, PATH. If the binary is unavailable the check is BLOCKED (mandatory) - a regex fallback scan is recorded separately and is NOT equivalent.

doc_links_scope.note: Links beginning with '/' are workspace-runtime framework links (e.g. /reference/AGENTS.default) and are not repo files. Third-party content (.agents/skills, projects/ai-tools) is out of scope.

check_overrides.fsck_note: git fsck --no-dangling is read-only; on a large local repo it may take ~2 minutes.
